name: OmegleWeb.io (Text Chat)
entry_flow: 18+ -> Start Text Chat -> Esc to skip
protection_summary: Strict keyword filter ('Do not ask for gender. This is not a dating site. Violators will be banned'). Avoid 'M or F' / 'asl' keywords.

classification.reason: Initial guess: DOM-driven stranger chat; run live probe to detect API/WebSocket endpoints

selectors.composer_input: textarea:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="message" i]:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="type" i]:not([disabled]), input[type="text"][placeholder*="say" i]:not([disabled]), [contenteditable="true"]
selectors.skip_button: button[aria-keyshortcuts="Escape"], button.skip-btn, button.stop-btn, button.next-btn, button[aria-label*="Skip" i], button[aria-label*="Stop" i], button[aria-label*="Leave" i]
selectors.chat_ended_text: stranger has disconnected|stranger left|chat has ended|you have disconnected|looking for a partner|finding a stranger
